name: Crayon Tulip ~Chidori to Koruri no Yuuwaku Jugyou~
original_name: くれよんちゅーりっぷ ～ちどりとこるりの誘惑授業～
source:
Jun is an aspiring teacher who has non-blood-related twin imoutos, Koruri and Chidori. One day their mother and older sister tell him that they are actually succubi. Succubi require a man’s essence to become adults and they wish that that he will help Koruri and Chidori become adults. He gets help from chibi teacher Tsubame to enter the girls-only boarding school that they are attending. For his precious imoutos, he will do anything...

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/10/01/october-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Jun是一位有抱负的教师，拥有非血缘关系的双胞胎妹妹Koruri和Chidori。有一天，他们的母亲和姐姐告诉他，他们实际上是魅魔。魅魔需要男人的本质才能成为成年人，她们希望他能帮助小琉璃和千鸟长大。他在赤壁老师燕的帮助下进入了她们就读的女子寄宿学校。为了他心爱的妹妹，他可以做任何事……

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/10/01/october-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
